summary: Added meterbill/money.py (round_amount, allocate, legacy_cents, fixed), routed every rounding and fixed-place formatting through it, removed the decimal-context line, and added tests/test_money.py. Output matched the original byte for byte on a fuzz of bills, batches, quotes and tariffs. Kept quirks: band charges and effective price round half-even in batch (worker threads never had the half-up context) but half-up elsewhere, via keyword-only method parameters; the 'whole' cash rule prints a zero without a sign.
